restart_argv: $t0=Get-Date; Stop-Service IRIS_c-_intersystems_iris -Force -ErrorAction Continue; while((Get-Service IRIS_c-_intersystems_iris).Status -ne 'Stopped' -and ((Get-Date)-$t0).TotalSeconds -lt 120){Start-Sleep 3}; Start-Service IRIS_c-_intersystems_iris -ErrorAction Continue; Start-Sleep 3; if ((Get-Service IRIShttpd).Status -ne 'Running') { Start-Service IRIShttpd -ErrorAction Continue }
note: restart_cmd is a presence gate for runner.py; restart_argv is what actually runs (argv list only - never nested quotes over WinRM). VM facts (CO.md + measured in B6): Restart-Service on the controller hangs its own pipeline (stop-wait-start works, ~30s); after a controller bounce IRIShttpd can stay Stopped or be mid-restart, so the poll loop re-asserts `sc.exe start IRIShttpd` every ~15s (harmless 1056 when already running) until the Atelier root answers 200.
